name: Mankrik
summary: At the Crossroads, Mankrik carries grief and a thirst for vengeance. A quilboar ambush separated him from his wife, Olgra, and he now hunts the bristled beasts across the Barrens.

sections.title: Ambush in the Dust
sections.body: Mankrik and his wife Olgra traveled through the Barrens when quilboar swarmed them during a skirmish at a small tauren settlement. The fighting tore them apart, and Mankrik saw Olgra vanish beneath tusks and thorn-woven weapons. Fury drove him to fight recklessly until a blow left him unconscious. Along the Gold Road, a passing tauren druid found Mankrik bleeding out and bound his injuries. He survived the ambush, but Olgra was gone.

sections.title: Consumed by Vengeance
sections.body: At the Crossroads, Mankrik recovers, paralyzed by grief and consumed by bloodlust. Thork and other local leaders warn that hatred has clouded his judgment, and they refuse to send official war parties. Mankrik refuses to move on. Uncertain of Olgra's fate, he calls on any willing Horde travelers to search the Barrens for signs of his lost mate and slaughter any quilboar they meet.

faq.answer: At the Crossroads in the Barrens, Mankrik is an orc warrior consumed by grief and rage. A quilboar ambush separated him from his wife, and he now seeks vengeance.
A swarm of quilboar cut Mankrik and Olgra off from each other during a clash at a tauren settlement. Mankrik was beaten down in the chaos, and Olgra disappeared amid the fighting.

faq.q: How did Mankrik survive the battle?
faq.answer: A tauren druid found Mankrik bleeding out along the Gold Road after he fell unconscious beneath the quilboar swarm. The druid bound his injuries and brought him to safety.

faq.q: Why does Thork refuse to help Mankrik?
faq.answer: Thork, the leader at the Crossroads, believes Mankrik's rage and thirst for vengeance have clouded his judgment and left him unable to act rationally.

angles.text: As an orc, you know family and honor are constantly tested against the threats on Kalimdor's wild frontiers.
At the Crossroads, you face the unrelenting threat of the bristled quilboar packs across the Barrens.
